newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: BFE to rise, BPI to fall after price news - dealers.
newsitem.headline: BFE to rise, BPI to fall after price news - dealers.

text.p: Shares in Portugal's Banco de Fomento e Exterior (BFE) should rise when a trading suspension is lifted at 1100 GMT but are unlikely to climb much above 2,550 escudos per share, dealers said.

The Lisbon bourse announced earlier that Banco Portugues de Investimento (BPI) had offered 2,615 escudos per share in its successful bid for 65 percent of BFE. BFE was quoted at 2,545 escudos before its suspension last week.
Dealers expected BPI shares to fall by as much as 100 escudos initially when the suspension is lifted. BPI last traded at 2,115 escudos.
